checkedAlternates.risk: Persistent cookies survive browser restarts like localStorage.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Unlike localStorage or IndexedDB, HTTP Cookies are automatically transmitted in HTTP request headers (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: sessionStorage shares the Web Storage interface with localStorage.
checkedAlternates.resolution: sessionStorage is cleared when the tab closes (group-2), whereas localStorage persists across sessions (group-3).
